title: 5 reasons you should be more tight-lipped with your chatbot (and how to fix past mistakes) | ZDNET
summary: Researchers are exploring the implications of sharing personal information with chatbots, which could potentially be used for surveillance or data breaches, as highlighted by incidents and concerns raised in the article.
